name: district4-culinary-guide
description: Multilingual Culinary Tourism & Audio Guide System for District 4, Ho Chi Minh City

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web,mobile -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter mobile start"
scripts.check:mobile: pnpm --filter mobile check:syntax && pnpm --filter mobile test
scripts.check:all: pnpm check:server && pnpm check:imports && pnpm check:api && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:mobile
